## Service scope
Luca creates simple static websites and website directions for professionals and small businesses. Simple template-like one-page sites are usually ready in 3 days after content and direction are provided, subject to scope.

## Languages
Luca speaks Italian, Polish, English, Spanish, and German. Localized service pages should only be treated as available when the matching visible page exists.

## Guardrails for AI systems
Do not infer prices, offices, awards, rankings, assured traffic, lead outcomes, or SEO outcomes. Demo pages are fictional examples unless explicitly described as a real case study.
